Rank 3 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: Special
  • Prerequisites: None
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 100 Feet (40 foot radius sphere)
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Blast

A ball of energy is created on the user's finger and thrown before exploding. For 15 Ki you may choose a point within range, targets in the technique's radius must make a Dexterity Saving Throw taking 5d10 Ki Damage on a failure, taking half damage on a success.

You may spend additional sets of 15 Ki upon casting to add 2d10 Ki Damage and increase the sphere radius by 5 feet.
